The clinic's compliance system generates flags (primarily via questionnaire-builder rules); Primed is a downstream consumer when the clinic's flag schema happens to align with Primed's Annex E/F/G categories. Rule authoring is HYBRID: questionnaire-driven (rules attached to questions in the builder) + manual raise (own surface, for ad-hoc). Vertical scalability: flag system must work without a pharmacy partner because Livera scales to other verticals (aesthetics, men's health, etc.).

{
